Amounts carry no currency symbol: they are in your currency. Tax on the menu price by market (cell "Tax rate (%)", 0% by default):
• US: menu prices are pre-tax and sales tax is added on the bill. Leave 0%.
• Canada: GST/HST is usually added on the bill, as in the US. Leave 0%.
• UK: printed prices must include VAT. Type 20% (most cold takeaway food is zero-rated, but not soft drinks, confectionery or crisps).
• Australia: prices include GST. Type 10%.
